metadata.description: Historical draft data for fantasy dynasty league

notes.Arron: Participated in 2023 only, replaced by Foss in 2024

notes: $ symbol indicates pick was a 'hit' based on performance criteria
&& symbol indicates player wasn't available at this pick
### symbol indicates team took extra player
(N) notation after player indicates starter status (1=1yr starter, 2=2yr starter, etc.)
Rounds 1-2 must be starter in 3 of first 5 years to 'hit'
Rounds 3-5 must be starter in 2 of first 5 years to 'hit'
Rounds 6+ need 1 year as starter in first 5 years to 'hit'
Some years (2018, 2017, 2016, 2015, 2014) show duplicate picks - may be shared draft or pre-league history
College abbreviations preserved from original data
NFL team assignments (team field) only present for 2024-2025 drafts
